RUNARCANA.PrimaryGMHint: Shared resource, rest and import changes are performed by the active primary GM.

Rest.Title: Complete a rest
Rest.Confirmation: Confirm the required duration, sleep, food and water. First-aid kits and class-specific exceptions remain manual. For multiclass full-rest recovery, use the API with a reviewed hit-dice allocation.

RUNARCANA.ProgressionHint: The native advancement manager previews the next level. Only exact matched source grants are automated; choices, multiclass rules and resource maxima need source verification.

Import.Policy: Preview before applying. Imports create native folders. Unedited copies can update; local edits and duplicates are skipped. Existing world copies require an explicit reimport after translation. A backup is stored for updates.

Creature.Manual: This calculator uses published role and hit-die formulas. Source inconsistencies are documented. AC, other attributes, abilities, runes, Echoes and attacks need GM review.
Creature.Name: Name

Error.Version: Runarcana requires dnd5e 6.0.6 on Foundry V14. The adapter was not enabled.
Error.SpellLevel: Spell level must be an integer from 0 to 9.
Error.NotMarked: The actor must be explicitly marked for Runarcana.
Error.Permission: You do not own this actor.
Error.PrimaryGM: This action requires the active primary GM.
Error.WorldDisabled: Enable Runarcana for this world first.
Error.Source: The source document cannot be resolved.
Error.FullRest: A full rest requires two completed long rests.
Error.RestTime: A long or full rest must complete at least 24 hours after the previous one.
Error.RestHP: At least one hit point is required at the start of a full rest.
Error.HitDiceAllocation: Multiclass hit dice recovery requires a valid manual allocation.
Error.UnreviewedRecipe: The crafting recipe must be reviewed and cite its source.
Error.ShortHitDie: Only one short-rest hit die may be spent before the next long rest.
Error.LevelLimit: No verified next level exists in this class source table.

Creation.Hint: Choose an origin and class, and enter ability scores already validated against the creation rules. Preview creates a draft character and opens the native origin and class advancement workflows. Regions, Pasts, equipment, multiclass restrictions and unresolved choices require GM review.
